context: Kenji visits the countryside for harvest visit. Casual adult masculine warmth.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 達也さん、ようやく、田舎、来れました。
lines.en: Tatsuya-san, I finally made it out to the countryside.
lines.style: Warm arrival energy — bright and genuine, like stepping out of a train. Pleased with himself. Steady, easy pace. The pleasure of being here lives in the openness of his voice.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: お、よう来てくれた。秋の収穫、見せたかった。
lines.en: Good you came. I wanted to show you the autumn harvest.
lines.style: Gruff welcome that softens as he speaks. Pride in what he's grown showing through without boasting. Steady, unhurried — the tempo of someone at home. Warm weight in the final phrase.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: Genuine impressed exhale on the opening. Eyes are bright. Quick beat of appreciation, then settles into warm observation. No performance — just real recognition of good work.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: 今年、特に良うできた。皆さんのお陰で、ええ取引、続いてるから。
lines.en: This year turned out especially good. Because of everyone's steady support, we've got solid trade going.
lines.style: Patient, humble — he's crediting others without false modesty. Slight dip of gratitude midway through. Closes with quiet confidence. The voice of someone comfortable saying thank you.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: こちらこそ、達也さんの野菜、本当に、ありがたい。
lines.en: That goes both ways. Your vegetables — honestly, they mean a lot to us.
lines.style: Sincere and reciprocal. Leans in slightly on the middle phrase. Not effusive, but the depth of actual gratitude is there. Steady eye contact in his voice. Warm and real.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: 皆で、一緒に、続けていけるの、ほんま、嬉しい。
lines.en: Being able to keep doing this together — that genuinely makes me happy.
lines.style: Quiet, reflective. Like he's speaking something he doesn't always say out loud. The words land with weight. Slow pace. Philosophical warmth — not sentimental, just honest.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 本当に。これからも、よろしくお願いします。
lines.en: It really does. I look forward to working with you going forward.
lines.style: Formal but warm — the words are traditional, but the delivery is personal. Slight bow in the voice. Steady close. The sincerity sits underneath the courtesy.
